responsibility: Drives compilation-unit level callgraph processing between the front ends and the IPA/back-end pipeline. It finalizes compilation units, triggers lowering and reachability analysis, handles alias diagnostics, runs the overall compile pipeline, manages debug/earlydebug dump streams, and provides unit-wide reset logic for rerunning the compiler in-process. It also contains wrapper/thunk creation support used when backend-side transformations need to synthesize callable bodies in the cgraph.
